title: OP Structures & Dungeons
description: Transforms every vanilla structure into an overpowered version with valuable blocks, upgraded loot tables, and massive rewards.
body:
Transform your Minecraft world with a completely **new exploration experience**! This datapack upgrades many vanilla structures by rebuilding them with valuable blocks and filling them with **powerful loot**, making every adventure more rewarding than ever before.

Explore redesigned **Villages, Woodland Mansions, Pillager Outposts, End Cities, Ruined Portals, Shipwrecks, Ocean Ruins, Trial Chambers, and many other structures,** all reimagined with valuable resources such as **Diamond, Emerald, Gold, Iron, Netherite, and other rare materials**. In addition, loot tables have been completely reworked, allowing you to discover **better gear, rare items, useful resources, and other valuable rewards throughout your journey.**

However, the **structures** listed above are **only part of the adventure**. Several more overpowered structures are hidden throughout the world, waiting to be discovered. Instead of revealing every surprise, this datapack encourages exploration and curiosity, giving you a reason to search every biome and investigate every structure you encounter.

_Whether you're starting a brand-new survival world or simply want a fresh and exciting challenge, this datapack makes exploration the main focus of your adventure. Every structure has the potential to become a memorable discovery, rewarding players who are willing to travel farther, explore deeper, and uncover every hidden secret._
